items.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart believed to have sprained MCL; X-rays negative, MRI Tuesday; expected to miss some time (positive overall). Ruled out mid-game; Winston in.
items.why: Knee injury on hit while throwing; initial exams indicate MCL sprain
items.implication: Winston or backup starts upcoming; Giants offense impacted short-term

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) officially inactive for MNF vs Giants. Najee Harris active for Giants debut.
items.why: Hip/groin issue; failed pregame workout after DNPs
items.implication: Davante Adams featured; secondary routes open for depth WRs/TEs
items.opportunity: Routes/targets shift to Adams primary, then Ferguson/Mumpfield

items.text: Eagles TE Dallas Goedert sprained MCL, likely miss a few weeks. Eagles signing Zach Ertz to practice squad with intent to promote.
items.why: MRI confirmed MCL sprain suffered blocking vs Titans
items.implication: TE depth thin (Mundt/Jenkins); Ertz reunion for receiving role; possible IR
items.opportunity: Targets to DeVonta Smith/Wicks; Ertz stash/elevate potential

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels dislocated left elbow; imaging done, consulting specialists. Marcus Mariota expected to start vs Seattle.
items.why: Dislocated left elbow falling awkwardly; prior elbow history
items.implication: Mariota starts Week 3; Daniels timeline TBD after consults; possible multi-week
items.opportunity: Commanders skill players see reduced ceiling with backup QB

items.text: Bears HC Ben Johnson: Caleb Williams week-to-week with hamstring (MRI done); expects miss some time. Same hamstring as prior injury. Bagent backup.
items.why: Hamstring pull on scramble; MRI confirms
items.implication: Bagent likely starts; Bears offense/ skill (Odunze/Loveland/Burden) ceiling drop

items.text: With Puka Nacua out, on 33 Stafford dropbacks: Davante Adams 27 routes, Terrance Ferguson 23, Konata Mumpfield 21, Xavier Smith 19, Atwell/Parkinson 10.
items.why: Nacua inactive; route tree redistribution measured
items.implication: Adams clear WR1; Ferguson/Mumpfield deep-league pivots if Nacua misses more
items.opportunity: High route share for Adams; secondary for depth

items.text: Giants RBs MNF (all four active; Tracy ST only): Cam Skattebo 34 snaps/16 opps, Singletary 15/4, Najee Harris 8/4.
items.why: Clear snap/opportunity lead despite four RBs active
items.implication: Skattebo lead back; Dart injury may further elevate or alter scheme

items.text: Colts WR Alec Pierce out several weeks rehabbing aggravated surgically-repaired heel; hoping return midseason, IR likely; surgery still possible.
items.why: Aggravated prior heel injury; rehab over immediate surgery
items.implication: Colts WR depth thins; Downs/others elevated targets

items.text: DeVonta Smith target shares 27%/38% first two games; leads WRs in expected PPR. RIDE. OR. DIE.
items.why: Elite target share and expected points early; Goedert absence may sustain
items.implication: Must-start WR1; elevated with Goedert out

items.text: Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) officially ACTIVE. RJ Harvey (hamstring) inactive. Grab Jonah Coleman if ignored preseason.
items.why: McConkey optimism/flak jacket; Harvey not expected/hamstring
items.implication: McConkey playable (docks); Dobbins lead, Coleman RB2 look in DEN
items.opportunity: Coleman handcuff/stash; McConkey volume if limited

items.text: Weekend status: GTD McConkey (optimism/flak), Nacua (hip). Not expected: RJ Harvey. Expected: Olave, Burrow, Black, McMillan (snap count). OUT: Flowers, Pittman.
items.implication: McConkey playable; Harvey/ Coleman look; Flowers/Pittman out pivots; Olave/Burrow clear

items.text: Saints: Etienne big free-agent deal yet Week 1 even split with Miller; Week 2 Miller healthy scratch, Kamara 15 opps vs Etienne 11. Kamara poor efficiency (1.7 YPC, 1.4 YPR).
items.why: Unexpected Kamara lead opps despite Etienne contract/Miller scratch; poor efficiency
items.implication: Etienne not clear lead; committee messy; monitor roles
items.opportunity: Unclear; Kamara volume but efficiency concern

items.text: Kyren Williams 7 opportunities inside 20 this season, Blake Corum 0. Last year: Kyren 60, Corum 27.
items.implication: Kyren locked as primary scorer; Corum limited even in split

items.text: Quentin Johnston YPRR by year: 2023 0.88, 2024 1.63, 2025 1.44, 2026 0.48 (inconceivably horrific).
items.why: Catastrophic efficiency drop early 2026 despite role
items.implication: Avoid/start-sit caution; McConkey return further squeezes
items.opportunity: Low YPRR signals poor separation/usage quality
